scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate && node --import tsx src/index.ts
scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@stoerdesk/shared=../../packages/shared/src/index.ts --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap && esbuild src/db/migrate.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@stoerdesk/shared=../../packages/shared/src/index.ts --outfile=dist/db/migrate.js --sourcemap && (node scripts/copy-migrations.mjs || node ../../scripts/copy-migrations.mjs)
